# Simplicytas

> Simplicytas is a consultancy and a solution for organisations whose numbers do not agree. We help customers build trust in their data by building a confidence level for every number, as high as the evidence allows. Software, method and people together.

Simplicytas Consulting Pte. Ltd. was founded in 2024 and is headquartered in Singapore. It is led by John Culleton, who has more than 30 years of experience leading transformation, operational excellence and performance improvement.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.simplicytas.com/): where data, execution and transformation break, and how Simplicytas works
- [How We Help](https://www.simplicytas.com/how-we-help/): Data360 first, with Procure360, Portfolio360 and Governance360 to add as priorities emerge
- [Results](https://www.simplicytas.com/results/): three cases across the Americas, APAC and Europe
- [Insights](https://www.simplicytas.com/insights/): short reads on private credit, real estate and private markets
- [About](https://www.simplicytas.com/about/): the team behind every engagement, and how to get in touch
